UPDATE jobs SET state = 'queued', attempts = 0, run_at = now(), locked_until = NULL,
               finished_at = NULL, result = NULL
           WHERE id IN (
               SELECT id FROM (
                   SELECT DISTINCT ON (dedupe_key) id, state FROM jobs
                   WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND kind = $2
                   ORDER BY dedupe_key, id DESC
               ) latest
               WHERE state = 'failed')
